baek-sion.name: Baek Si-on
baek-sion.role: The protagonist · Debt collector, then actor
baek-sion.desc: Raised between Seoul and Los Angeles, pushed onto the stage by a father who believed the Hallyu wave would carry his son to the top. He spent two years in the Korean military, then woke up carrying the name — and the memory — of a life he never lived.

yoon-hyeja.name: Yoon Hye-ja
yoon-hyeja.meta: Mid-40s · steel behind a calm face
yoon-hyeja.desc: Short hair, hard eyes, and a way of putting two billion won on the table because she doesn't want her son eating meatless lunchboxes on set.

baek-jeonghun.name: Baek Jeong-hun
baek-jeonghun.desc: Too thin, too tired, a pencil behind his ear and a screenplay six years in the making. With a nephew he barely knows, he finally climbs the stairs of his brother's house.

lee-ji-eun.name: Lee Ji-eun (IU)
lee-ji-eun.meta: The Nation's Little Sister · real-name counterpart
lee-ji-eun.desc: The one the whole country calls its little sister. When a fan letter about a half-basement and a debt collector reaches her hands, she does the one thing her manager warns her against: she decides to help.

kim-sejeong.name: Kim Se-jeong
kim-sejeong.role: The debtor's daughter, dreaming of the stage
kim-sejeong.meta: She works the grill · idolises IU
kim-sejeong.desc: She counts the hours and hides a letter to her favourite singer under her mattress. The worst thing in the world and the best thing in the world can be the same person.

goo-hara.name: Goo Hara
goo-hara.meta: KARA's visual, kind even under fire
goo-hara.desc: Born 1991 in Gwangju. The one who, while her own group stood blockaded by fans, still had the presence of mind to hand a near-stranger a name and a number.

song-qian.name: Song Qian (Victoria)
song-qian.meta: Born Song Qian in Qingdao · on stage, Victoria
song-qian.desc: The first Chinese leader of an SM girl group. f(x)'s anchor — the one the practice room quietly leans on, and the one pressing record when the others have stopped.

jung-jae-joon.name: Jung Jae-joon
jung-jae-joon.meta: The ear that finds the note
jung-jae-joon.desc: An underground producer working out of a cluttered fourth-floor studio. To Baek Si-on he is less a business partner than a translator, reading a picture in someone's head and writing it in sound.

son-namwon.name: Son Nam-won
son-namwon.meta: The man who lives by the scoop
son-namwon.desc: The kind of editor who dug with his mouth instead of his feet. Publicly bruised by Dispatch and afraid of losing a second exclusive, he is exactly the audience a half-exclusive was built for.

park-jihun.name: Park Ji-hun
park-jihun.meta: Three years of artist styling at a Cheongdam-dong salon
park-jihun.desc: The front-desk stylist who chased Baek Si-on out of the shop to offer himself. Three years in artist styling, a portfolio ready, and the good sense to read a million-won membership card for the door it was.

irene.name: Irene
irene.desc: The calm at the centre of a debuting group, the one who calls "one, two, three" and makes four voices land on the same syllable. On the day Red Velvet debuted she sized up Baek Si-on's name on the sheet of A4, shut the nostalgia gate in her own head, and led the four of them through the bow.

seulgi.name: Kang Seul-gi
seulgi.desc: The member who leans half her body out from behind the leader's shoulder to ask the question nobody else will — bright, unguarded, and the first to let her curiosity slip out before the politeness catches up.

wendy.name: Son Seung-wan
wendy.desc: The kind of face that makes a room decide to be friendly; the member whose warmth reads even in a crowd of strangers, and the one who makes it okay to be nervous out loud.

joy.name: Park Soo-young
joy.desc: The maknae, the one who leans slightly toward Irene in the dark of a broadcast hall to ask whether Baek sunbae can really take number one. Her optimism comes in its youngest, least armoured form.

daddario.name: Alexandra Daddario
daddario.desc: The woman who sits down across from the man eating alone in the dark and tells him he is either the least interested or the hungriest person on the beach. Direct in a way Seoul's politeness never is — and the first on that beach not to come away with a phone number.

luisa-ranieri.name: Luisa Ranieri
luisa-ranieri.role: Italian actress · host & red carpet, Venice
luisa-ranieri.desc: The face of the Venice red carpet — the Italian actress who draws the flashbulbs and opens the night. Warm, unhurried, and photographed against the Lido's sea-light; the woman who makes the premiere feel less like a competition and more like a night out.

tim-roth.name: Tim Roth
tim-roth.role: British actor · president of the main competition, Venice
tim-roth.desc: The jury president — an English actor with a name known to every filmmaker in the room, and a gaze that weighs a film in a single pass. Where he sits, the whole conversation between the jury and the press pivots.

alexandre-desplat.name: Alexandre Desplat
alexandre-desplat.desc: One of the great living film composers — the man whose name on a poster already promises a certain sound. On the jury he is the quiet one who listens for the score beneath the picture.

sandy-powell.name: Sandy Powell
sandy-powell.desc: A costume designer with an Oscar shelf, and a sharp eye for what a single seam can do. The woman who will notice the gown before anyone else notices the wearer — and the voice that settles whether a red carpet is talk or is art.

jessica-hausner.name: Jessica Hausner
jessica-hausner.desc: An Austrian director of precise, unsettling films. On the jury she is the one who looks at a picture the way a surgeon looks at a cut — calmly, and far too closely.

philip-groning.name: Philip Gröning
philip-groning.desc: A German documentarian of slow, patient films — the sort who can hold a shot long enough to watch a person change their mind. He brings the patience of the monastery to the prize table.

elia-suleiman.name: Elia Suleiman
elia-suleiman.desc: A filmmaker of deadpan comic stillness, forever watching borders and the small absurdities in between. On the jury he is the one who laughs at the wrong moment — and is usually right to.

dean-choi.name: Dean Choi
dean-choi.role: Dean · School of Film, TV and Multimedia · K-Arts
dean-choi.meta: OC · tortoise-shell glasses · a vanity that did its own typing
dean-choi.desc: He invites a trophy into a school and would like the school to remember who opened the door. He speaks in complete sentences. The students have learned to wait for the full stop.

seo-eunju.name: Seo Eun-ju
seo-eunju.meta: OC · she doesn’t do song splits · she does the other kind of money
seo-eunju.desc: Mid-thirties, a navy blazer, an ivory blouse, a chain so fine it only caught when she turned her head. Jeong Han-teuk sent the card. She does not do first meetings in offices. She does them over soft tofu, where a man has to put his phone down to use a spoon.

song-kangho.name: Song Kang-ho
song-kangho.role: Actor · Memories of Murder, The Host, The Attorney
song-kangho.meta: Real-name counterpart · the smoke he had been promised
song-kangho.desc: The smile is not a performance. It is a decision to be in the room. He calls Bong Joon-ho Bong-suk the way a man calls a younger brother a name that will outlive both of them.

lee-joonik.name: Lee Joon-ik
lee-joonik.role: Director · King and the Clown, Sado
lee-joonik.meta: Real-name counterpart · Buam, a kettle, a prince who has not yet been cast as a yes
lee-joonik.desc: Shaved head, round glasses, a mouth that smiles as if smiling were a way of not wasting a morning. He pours the tea first. The tea is the first scene.

scooter-braun.name: Scooter Braun
scooter-braun.role: Manager · SB Projects · the rooms that do not send e-mail when the question is a person
scooter-braun.meta: Real-name counterpart · West Hollywood, a table, twenty percent that is a map
scooter-braun.desc: He smiles as if smiling were a first clause. Justin. Ariana. A list that is not the point. The point is a week if you have a week, and a territory a cousin in Seoul cannot cover from a gate.

justin-bieber.name: Justin Bieber
justin-bieber.role: Singer · SB Projects · the man who still tweets at midnight
justin-bieber.meta: Real-name counterpart · Matsuhisa, a blonde head, a tweet that is a pipe
justin-bieber.desc: He eats like a boy who has been famous too long to remember being hungry. He tells a Best Actor to drop a song and then, three days later, does the work of telling a continent. Controversy and traffic have never been opposites.

ariana-grande.name: Ariana Grande
ariana-grande.role: Singer · SB Projects · a high note that arrives before the introduction is finished
ariana-grande.meta: Real-name counterpart · Matsuhisa, a ponytail, a nickname she hands over herself
ariana-grande.desc: She sits down as if sitting were a decision she had already made. She tells a Korean Best Actor to call her Ari. She does not ask whether the table is a table she is allowed to occupy.

park-jimin.name: Park Ji-min
park-jimin.role: Vocal · Big Hit · Bangtan Sonyeondan · Jimin
park-jimin.meta: Real-name counterpart · a small body that occupies more stage than the body should
park-jimin.desc: He is listed on a sunset flyer under a name the West has not yet learned to say. He does not speak first. He does not need to. The body is the sentence.

jeon-jungkook.name: Jeon Jung-kook
jeon-jungkook.role: Vocal · Big Hit · Bangtan Sonyeondan · Jungkook
jeon-jungkook.meta: Real-name counterpart · the maknae, a stare that has not yet learned to hide
jeon-jungkook.desc: He is the youngest. The flyer says so in a font that does not care. He watches a Best Actor the way a boy watches a door that has just opened in a wall he thought was solid.

min-yoongi.name: Min Yoon-gi
min-yoongi.role: Rapper · producer · Big Hit · Bangtan Sonyeondan · SUGA
min-yoongi.meta: Real-name counterpart · a mouth that does not waste a line, a beat that does not wait to be invited
min-yoongi.desc: He is the one who will later make a studio feel like a room that has opinions. Tonight he is a name on a flyer and a boy who does not clap because clapping is a sentence he has not decided to say.

jung-hoseok.name: Jung Ho-seok
jung-hoseok.role: Rapper · dancer · Big Hit · Bangtan Sonyeondan · J-Hope
jung-hoseok.meta: Real-name counterpart · a smile that does the work of a light, a body that does the work of a drum
jung-hoseok.desc: He is the one the audience finds with the eyes first. Hope, on a flyer, looks like a slogan. On a stage it looks like a boy who has decided the sunset is a cue, not a mood.

hwang-sooah.name: Hwang Soo-ah
hwang-sooah.meta: OC · nail holes, a MacBook, a snap when two people start a fire too early
hwang-sooah.desc: She books apartments that have been lived in. She will not unmask an actor too soon. Natural, she says, and means a couple who actually dated.

yoo-inna.name: Yoo In-na
yoo-inna.role: Actress · DJ · MBC Raise the Volume
yoo-inna.meta: Real · a honey voice, a chair that has already decided you will talk
yoo-inna.desc: Eleven years not debuting as a singer. Then the voice a nation leaves on in the car. She will not let a guest hide behind a prize.

jeanie-buss.name: Jeanie Buss
jeanie-buss.meta: Real · Staples Center · the afternoon before the opener
jeanie-buss.desc: The president who ends a stranger’s rehearsal by walking over to shake his hand, take one photo, and send her assistant after his sister with a business card. Partnership talks, she notes, are worth having later.

james-harden.name: James Harden
james-harden.desc: The Beard with two drives and a drawn foul who reminds twenty thousand people that Kobe’s comeback night is not a documentary. He plans the upset from the mouth of the tunnel and does not plan on losing.

dwight-howard.name: Dwight Howard
dwight-howard.meta: Real · October 2014 · the elbow at the centre of everything
dwight-howard.desc: Elbows out, hands spread, grinning wider the louder the boos get. His defensive rebound starts the fight, and his elbow — swung from two hundred and sixty pounds away — is what nearly ends Baek Si-on’s night.

adam-levine.name: Adam Levine
adam-levine.desc: The frontman who calls Baek Si-on’s pre-game show the best he has seen all year, presses a demo into his ear and asks him for a video idea — then spends the rest of the night physically keeping the same singer away from Dwight Howard.

behati.name: Behati Prinsloo
behati.meta: Real · the one Adam calls Little Pumpkin
behati.desc: The Victoria’s Secret model who reaches across her husband to press down the same singer’s other arm — and then calls the whole near-death moment “sweet.”
